name: watchkeeper-panel
description: See your Claude Code sessions and the subagents they started, in a panel beside your code; with the Watchkeeper plugin, also usage pace, spend, jobs and the Gemini queue. The panel itself makes no network calls; sends nothing to Nexodyne; no telemetry.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In a folder you have not trusted, Watchkeeper shows your sessions but runs nothing: answering, deciding, adding a task, jobs and the phone controls are off.

watchkeeper.pluginPath.markdownDescription: Folder of the Watchkeeper plugin (holds `bin/wk-ledger.mjs` and `config/gates.json`). Empty: found automatically, first `~/Projects/watchkeeper`, then the plugin as Claude Code installed it.

watchkeeper.dataDir.markdownDescription: The Watchkeeper plugin's data folder (ledger, meter, notes).

watchkeeper.claudeDir.markdownDescription: Claude Code's folder (session transcripts live in `projects/`).

watchkeeper.orchestrationDir.markdownDescription: Optional: a folder that holds `locks/`, one file per locked area, first line `pid|label|since`. Empty: the `orchestration` folder of the open workspace, if it has one. Questions come only from the folder named as "orchestration" in `~/.wk/remote.json`.
